blocks.text: The failure of the owner to remove a traffic hazard within 10 days after notice shall constitute an offense punishable by a penalty of $10.00, and every day such owner shall fail to remove such hazard shall be a separate and distinct offense. (Ord. 19407 § 5, 4-13-10. Code 1995 § 130-555.)
